name: EventsIntroBand - Closing Flush Against The Calendar
description: The banner /events actually renders, captured apart from EventsIntro because the two now differ in more than spacing. This is the shared page banner — the same one chapters, sponsors and blog posts open with — so /events no longer has a title treatment of its own. The scenario's NAME is now historical and worth reading as such: this band used to close with no bottom padding so the Luma calendar read as one block with it, avoiding 78px of nothing between the standfirst and the calendar's own 78px. The shared banner replaced that — it closes with its own padding and a hairline rule, so the calendar below is a separate block rather than a continuation. That is the deliberate trade: one banner on every page, against a piece of per-page spacing tuning. The band exists at all so pages/events.astro stays imports and composition with no raw markup of its own.
